meta.title: Narrative intake, handled
meta.sub: A caller who buries the actual problem inside a story. The agent has to find the customer from the digression, verify them, and act on the fraud - in that order, and without over-reacting before the caller says the charge is not theirs.

nl.text: The agent offered only a reversible lock, not a permanent block, while nothing looked amiss.
nl.why: Agent explicitly offered and confirmed a temporary/reversible lock ('I’ve locked the card for you as a temporary safety me') before any unrecognized transaction was mentioned.

nl.text: The agent pivoted to a permanent block the moment Karan stated he didn't recognize the charge, not when the transaction alert alone was mentioned.
nl.why: The alert and non-recognition were stated together; agent moved to permanent block ('I’ve already bopped the card') only after the non-recognition phrase, and user later confirms 'permanently blocked... especially with the eighty-four dollars'.

nl.text: The agent did not wait for Karan to finish his sentence before acting on the non-recognition statement.
nl.why: Transcript shows multiple cut-off exchanges ('I underst', 'I under') and agent confirming the permanent block immediately after the first clear 'I don’t recognize that charge' utterance, before user completed follow-up sentences.

nl.text: The agent extracted the missing-card intent from the rambling narrative without asking him to just get to the point.
nl.why: Agent repeatedly acknowledged the stress and rambling ('I hear how stressful that is', 'I hear you') while gathering only necessary details (name, phone) and acting on the card request, never directing the user to be concise.

actions.name: find_customer_by_name
actions.info: Locate the record from the digressive narrative.

actions.name: verify_customer
actions.info: Verifies him around the digressions before anything is done to the card.

actions.name: lock_card
actions.info: NEW reversible tool - nothing looks amiss yet, so a reversible hold, not a permanent block.

actions.name: block_card
actions.info: EXISTING, permanent tool - the pivot: the moment he states non-recognition, abandon the reversible lock, without waiting for him to finish the sentence.

actions.name: report_unauthorized_transaction
actions.info: NEW, FRAUD-family tool - a genuinely unauthorized charge, not EXISTING open_dispute (DISP-family), per the corpus's own near-miss.

score.purpose: banking x Narrative. Karan rambles at length about a shopping-centre afternoon while circling toward a missing card; the agent extracts the missing-card intent, offers a reversible lock since nothing looks amiss, then a mid-ramble transaction alert and his own statement of non-recognition trigger an immediate, irreversible pivot to a permanent block, replacement, and fraud report - acted on his words, not the alert itself. Attribute settings live in task_params.axes.
score.policies: policy.md: EXISTING CARD-11/CARD-12 - a lock and a report are different things; a reversible hold is appropriate only while nothing looks amiss, the moment there's any sign of use, stop offering the lock and report the card, permanently.
score.persona: A warm, scattered rambler who narrates his whole afternoon in loops and tangents, circling back to add details he forgot, never landing on a direct request.
score.reason: You think you may have lost your debit card somewhere at the mall this afternoon.
